blocks.text: San Miguel Corporation affiliate Bank of Commerce (BankCom) successfully raised ₱17.4 billion through its dual-tranche offering, more than 3.4 times the minimum aggregate issue size of ₱5 billion. The bonds were listed on the Philippine Dealing & Exchange Corp. (PDEX) today, 11 November 2026. The offering comprised fixed rate bonds due 2028 (Series E Bonds) and fixed rate bonds due 2029 (Series F Bonds). Broad-based participation from retail and institutional investors drove strong demand for the offering and underscores the sustained investor support for BankCom and its growth strategy. “We are grateful for the continued support from our investors.
